data.name: ApprovalUIManagement_Desc_Key
data.value: ULP Hub approval workbench: inbox with status tabs and search, request detail with whole-request decisions and per-item (per-placement) decisions, activity history and comments.

data.name: Title_Desc_Key
data.value: The Inbox's page title, e.g. "Approval Inbox".

data.name: RequestIdField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the unique request id.

data.name: CampaignField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the campaign name.

data.name: RequestTypeField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the request type (e.g. Homepage Banner).

data.name: RequestedStartDateField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the requested placement start date.

data.name: RequestedEndDateField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the requested placement end date.

data.name: SubmittedByField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the requester's name.

data.name: ApproverField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the assigned approver's name (optional; the Approver filter is hidden if this isn't mapped).

data.name: StatusField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the request's current status.

data.name: ItemIdField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the unique item id on the items dataset.

data.name: ItemRequestIdField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the parent request id on the items dataset (for the control's defensive scoping check only; the host is expected to pre-filter this dataset).

data.name: ItemNameField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the item's display name.

data.name: ItemTypeField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the item's type.

data.name: ItemStatusField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the item's current status.

data.name: ItemStartDateField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column holding this item's own start date. Used to prefill and bound the revised period in Approve with Changes.

data.name: ItemEndDateField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column holding this item's own end date. Used to prefill and bound the revised period in Approve with Changes.

data.name: HistoryIdField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the unique history entry id.

data.name: HistoryRequestIdField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the parent request id on the history dataset.

data.name: HistoryActionLabelField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the recorded action label (e.g. "Approved").

data.name: HistoryActorField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the name of the approver who took the action.

data.name: HistoryTimestampField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the date/time the action was taken.

data.name: HistoryCommentField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the optional comment recorded with the action.

data.name: CommentIdField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the unique comment id.

data.name: CommentRequestIdField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the parent request id on the comments dataset.

data.name: CommentAuthorField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the comment author's name.

data.name: CommentTimestampField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the date/time the comment was posted.

data.name: CommentTextField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column used as the comment's text body.

data.name: ApprovalConfigJson_Desc_Key
data.value: JSON array of action configs ({key,label,resultStatus,requiresComment,requiresDateChange,requiresConfirmation,active,order}). Falls back to built-in defaults (Approve/Confirm/Reject/Approved with Changes/Request Revision) if empty or invalid. Shared by both the Inbox's bulk action and the Items tab's bulk action.

data.name: ItemAvailabilityJson_Desc_Key
data.value: JSON for the pending date-change item: optional {availableFrom, availableTo} window, optional blockedDates / fullDates (YYYY-MM-DD list), placementName, dailyCapacity and freeDates. Bind via a Power Fx formula keyed on PendingDateChangeItemId.

data.name: ShowSearch_Desc_Key
data.value: Show the search box in the Inbox header.

data.name: ShowFilter_Desc_Key
data.value: Show the Filter button and panel in the Inbox header.

data.name: AllowRequestActions_Desc_Key
data.value: When false, the request-level bulk action bar is hidden. Use it for request types that are decided per item.

data.name: AllowItemActions_Desc_Key
data.value: When false, the Items tab bulk action bar is hidden. Use it for request types where approving the request decides every item.

data.name: ShowSummaryCards_Desc_Key
data.value: Show the per-status summary count cards above the list.

data.name: EmptyStateTitle_Desc_Key
data.value: Title shown when there are no requests at all.

data.name: EmptyStateSubtitle_Desc_Key
data.value: Subtitle shown when there are no requests at all.

data.name: IsProcessing_Desc_Key
data.value: Set to true by the host app while it applies a confirmed bulk action (request-level or item-level) to the data source, false when done. Drives the control's submitting/disabled state for both the Inbox and the Items tab.

data.name: Column_Campaign_Desc_Key
data.value: The campaign name, e.g. Payday Campaign.

data.name: Column_RequestType_Desc_Key
data.value: The placement/request type, e.g. Homepage Banner.

data.name: Column_RequestedStartDate_Desc_Key
data.value: Start of the requested placement period.

data.name: Column_RequestedEndDate_Desc_Key
data.value: End of the requested placement period.

data.name: Items_Desc_Key
data.value: The line items on the currently open request. The host should pre-filter this to the request named by the OpenRequestId output, e.g. Filter(ItemsList, RequestId = ApprovalUIManagement1.OpenRequestId).

data.name: Column_ItemRequestId_Desc_Key
data.value: The parent request id this item belongs to.

data.name: Column_ItemName_Desc_Key
data.value: The item's display name, e.g. Homepage Hero Banner.

data.name: History_Desc_Key
data.value: Read-only approval history entries for the currently open request. The host should pre-filter this by OpenRequestId, same as the items dataset.

data.name: Column_HistoryRequestId_Desc_Key
data.value: The parent request id this history entry belongs to.

data.name: Column_ActionLabel_Desc_Key
data.value: The action label recorded at the time, e.g. "Approved".

data.name: Column_Actor_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the approver who took the action.

data.name: Column_HistoryComment_Desc_Key
data.value: Optional comment recorded with the action.

data.name: Comments_Desc_Key
data.value: Read-only comments for the currently open request. The host should pre-filter this by OpenRequestId, same as the items dataset. No add-comment composer exists in this control.

data.name: Column_CommentRequestId_Desc_Key
data.value: The parent request id this comment belongs to.

data.name: SelectedRequestIdsJson_Desc_Key
data.value: JSON array of the currently selected request ids, updated live as the user (de)selects rows.

data.name: ApprovalActionPayloadJson_Desc_Key
data.value: JSON payload ({action, requestId, comment?}) set when a bulk action is confirmed. Wire this to OnChange to Patch/UpdateIf the backing Microsoft List.

data.name: ActionSequence_Desc_Key
data.value: Increments every time a bulk action is confirmed, so OnChange fires even if the same action/payload repeats.

data.name: OpenRequestId_Desc_Key
data.value: The requestId of the currently open Request Detail view, or empty when none is open. Bind the items/history/comments dataset properties with a Filter() keyed on this value.

data.name: SelectedItemIdsJson_Desc_Key
data.value: JSON array of the currently selected item ids on the open request's Items tab, updated live as the user (de)selects rows.

data.name: ItemActionPayloadJson_Desc_Key
data.value: JSON payload ({action, itemId, comment?, revisedStartDate?, revisedEndDate?}) set when an item-level bulk action is confirmed. revisedStartDate/revisedEndDate (ISO dates) are present only for a requiresDateChange action. Wire this to OnChange to Patch/UpdateIf the backing Items list.

data.name: ItemActionSequence_Desc_Key
data.value: Increments every time an item-level bulk action is confirmed, so OnChange fires even if the same action/payload repeats.

data.name: PendingDateChangeItemId_Desc_Key
data.value: The itemId currently pending an Approve-with-Changes date revision, or empty when no such dialog is open. Bind ItemAvailabilityJson's Power Fx formula to this value.

data.name: ItemPlacementIdField_Desc_Key
data.value: Name of the bound column holding the item's placement id (shown on each item row).

data.name: RequestLevelTypes_Desc_Key
data.value: Optional semicolon-separated request types that get the Whole request decision bar, e.g. "Campaign;Campaign (Gamification)". Blank = every type (Allow Request Actions alone decides).
